## What changed and why

Link the task/need/effort and describe the useful outcome. Identify agent-assisted work.

## Evidence and limitations

List public sources, observation dates, what you actually checked, contrary evidence and unknowns. For new efforts, identify the operator and Scripture access path. Cataloging does not imply participation.

## Verification

- [ ] I searched for duplicates and existing alternatives.
- [ ] Records and generated outputs are consistent (`npm run generate`, `npm run validate`).
- [ ] Relevant tests pass (`npm test`), with any limits reported.
- [ ] No credentials, private reader data, licensed Scripture payloads or fabricated evidence are included.
- [ ] I have the right to submit this material under the repository’s contribution terms.

Passing checks is not content approval. A changed commit requires renewed central review.
